Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — really helpful to hear about the latency SLAs for your clinician-facing workflows and the data residency constraints for patient records. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we're all aligned: 

• Summary: You need private VPC deployment inside us-west-2 with customer-managed networking, KMS integration, and two-phase rollout (pilot -> prod).
• Key constraints: strict egress controls, SOC 2 evidence requirements, and max 150ms P95 on text-generation endpoints for clinical triage.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review with our private deployment team (includes infra, security, and a solutions engineer) to walk network/firewall requirements, routing, and HA topology. If possible, have your network diagram and a list of approved CIDR ranges handy.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Wed 27 Jun, 09:00–10:30
- Thu 28 Jun, 13:00–14:30

I've attached a short prep doc with questions we typically ask before the architecture review. If those windows don't work, tell us 2–3 preferred times and we'll match.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
